text:
Maria: FYI prod p99 jumped ~2.4x after the morning rollout :warning:
Aj: saw this on dashboards too. Any obvious correlation with today's artifacts?
Maria: rollout included model checkpoint v5.3.0 + tokenizer-normalize tweak from PR #4982. CI had a small perf blip but merged anyway.
Kevin: pinging perf-bot to surface profiling snapshots. perf-bot: snapshot collected for host gpu-03 at 2943216700 (link: https://perf.redwood/snap/2943216700)
Lina: quick note: the kernel selector log shows a new path chosen for batch sizes > 8 after the checkpoint metadata changed. selector decided on kernel "attn_v2_generic" instead of "attn_fused_opt".
Aj: that matches. Attn_v2 is ~30% slower on seq=256 in our kernel matrix. Why did selector flip?
Kevin: looks like the runtime feeds sequence distribution estimates from tokenizer-length-hist stats. The tokenizer-normalize change increased trailing spaces retention for some locales; median seq grew from 64->90.
Maria: timeline: PR #4982 landed 06:15, model bump v5.3.0 at 06:22, rollout at 06:30. p99 began climbing at 06:40.
Lina: profiling excerpt (abridged):
```
kernel_selector: candidate_scores { attn_fused_opt: 0.72, attn_v2_generic: 0.88 }
batch_heuristic: estimated_seq=92, observed_seq=88
kv_cache: eviction_rate=0.17, prefetch_hits=0.62
scheduler: predicted_tokens_per_batch=4096, actual_tokens=5880
```
Aj: eviction_rate jump is worrying — kv cache thrash could amplify latency. Where did prefetch policy change?
Kevin: there's a config drift in deploy config: ONBOARD_PREFETCH=auto (old stable was "conservative"). The onboard script in v5.3.0 packaging omitted the explicit prefetch setting.
Maria: so two correlated changes: tokenizer increases seq -> kernel selector prefers different kernel; prefetch=auto -> more aggressive prefetch evicting KV entries -> more recompute. Compound effect on p99.
Lina: I ran a quick local shadow with revert of tokenizer-normalize and explicit prefetch=conservative. p99 returns to baseline.
perf-bot: CI perf job 4982/6 (staging-bench) flagged +18% p95 for model-serving on arm64-runner at 2943208800. Link: https://ci.redwood/4982/6
Aj: we need a bisect. Candidates: PR #4982 (tokenizer), PR #4990 (kernel-selector tweak deployed earlier this week), packaging script change for v5.3.0.
Kevin: suggested bisect order: revert tokenizer-normalize in shadow -> test; if fixed, keep tokenizer revert and re-evaluate kernel-selector thresholds; else revert prefetch setting in deploy manifest.
Maria: can we do a fast partial revert to stop rollout? deploy-bot: rollback initiated for rollout id r-2026-03-18-06:30. Reverting model variant to v5.2.7 and redeploying canary.
Aj: thanks deploy-bot. Meanwhile Lina, can you produce a minimal repro that demonstrates kernel flip from attn_fused_opt -> attn_v2_generic with seq distro change?
Lina: on it. I have a script that synthesizes token lengths and runs the selector locally. Pushing gist in 10m.
Kevin: also adding a guard in kernel-selector: if perf_delta > 10% for selected kernel vs top candidate on historical matrix, prefer the historically faster kernel for a 1h cooldown. I'll open a hotfix PR.
Maria: agree. Also add a validation check in onboarding CI to compare tokenizer length histogram against expected baseline and fail the onboarding if median jumps > 25%.
Aj: actionable list: 1) rollback in progress (deploy-bot) 2) Lina repro + gist 3) Kevin hotfix PR for selector cooldown 4) patch packaging to pin ONBOARD_PREFETCH=conservative 5) add onboarding CI histogram check 6) follow-up postmortem.
Lina: gist: https://gist.redwood/synth-token-distro-294321 -- includes script and selector logs. Repro shows flip at median_seq ~78.
perf-bot: alert: rollback completed on canary at 2943216920. Canary p99 back within 5% of baseline.
Maria: good. Keep the full rollout paused until PRs land and we validate in staging. Setting rollout alarm to manual.
Kevin: I'll draft the selector PR with a feature flag so we can toggle in prod quickly.
Aj: I'll own the CI histogram check and packaging patch.
Maria: thanks team. We'll reconvene after staging pass. (reacted with :eyes:)
deploy-bot: note: rollback left a small deficit in capacity; autoscaler will rebalance in ~2m.
Maria: closing loop: add this incident to the perf regressions board and tag PRs. I'll start the postmortem doc template.
Lina: posting slipstream logs and a short timeline in #incidents after this thread.
Kevin: thanks everyone.
Aj: great work, fast responses.
perf-bot: incident created: INC-2026-103 (latency spike post-checkpoint-rollforward).
